meta.description: Registry for symbolic stability conditions for delta branch-growth control under branch-width perturbation in Phase 3.

symbolic_stability_conditions.statement: delta may produce multiple admissible continuation candidates, but branch count is bounded when branch_pruning constraints apply.
Branch-width perturbation B -> B' remains within declared bounded_width_retention or admissibility-pruning limits.
At least one admissible continuation remains after pruning when MT-003 non-empty image conditions hold.
No branch explosion occurs unless pruning constraints are disabled, undefined, or exceeded.
transition_flux remains conditionally bounded under projection, pruning, and admissibility constraints.
Multi-valued delta remains non-deterministic; symbolic stability does not imply unique continuation.
